title: Skin Knowledge Portal Downloads
bodyHtml: This page lists files available for public download that are hosted by the Skin Knowledge Portal resource and linked Community Portals. Links for downloads of files from external sources, when available, are shown on individual Dataset pages.

dataTableLegendHtml:
Click on a column header to sort the table by that column. Filter the table using the filters above:

  • enter the full or partial name of a dataset into the Dataset name filter and hit Return
  • enter the full or partial name of a first author, publication title, or journal into the Publication filter and hit Return
  • filter by data type using the Data type pull-down menu
  • enter the full or partial name of a phenotype group into the Phenotype groups filter and hit Return to see datasets relevant to those phenotypes

Multiple filters may be combined.
